tonight.headline: 29.1 behind — Golden, Jacobs and Pickens are what is left
body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely 3.2, Garrett Wilson 4.6 and the Jets D/ST 1 — and Ollie Gordon's 17.3 sat on your bench. ESPN gives you 6%, 60.82 to 89.96.

Your lineup is right and only Pickens is unlocked. Golden, Jacobs and Gay are playing now; Pickens plays Monday. Furia Regia still have Love, McBride and Dobbins in progress and CeeDee Lamb on Monday.

case.label: The script that wins it
case.body: Golden and Jacobs both finish big at Detroit and Pickens beats his 13.2 against a Philadelphia side without DeVonta Smith or Wicks (RotoWire DAL-PHI), while Love and Lamb stall for Furia Regia. It needs most of that.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Only Pickens can still move: if Dallas rule him out before 18:20 CDMX tonight, Worthy goes in; after Worthy locks, nothing.

doFirst.title: Claim Colston Loveland, drop C.J. Stroud
doFirst.subtitle: Kmet is out for the season and Likely's Giants are on bye in Week 8. Stroud's job ended today and Houston are off next week.

case.label: The player
case.body: 12 targets and 19.9 points Thursday (archive); Cole Kmet went on IR with a season-ending knee (Fantasy Footballers 23 Oct) and Sam Roush is the only other tight end (Fantasy Footballers 24 Oct: Loveland 'remains the primary option'). Still on IPADE waivers at 22:05Z.

case.label: Why priority
case.body: Bloodsports sit 5th in an order that never resets. STRATEGY §4 spends it only on someone who starts at once: Likely is on bye in Week 8 and the flex takes a tight end, so Loveland starts in Week 8 and has a flex route after. This week's other lesson — the Gordon claim that never started — is exactly what this one is not.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Stroud: Week 7 cover for Daniels, final at 16.0, Houston on bye in Week 8. Not Rice — out again tonight but ESPN still carries 156 rest-of-season. The claim processes after Stroud's game, so the drop is legal.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Claim made and Loveland draws under 6 targets in two of Weeks 8-10 (archive); or Daniels misses a game in Weeks 8-10 and the free-agent cover scores less than Stroud did that week.

doFirst.sources: Fantasy Footballers 23-24 Oct · ESPN archive and wire 22:05Z

doFirst.deadlineLabel: WHEN THE WEEK ROLLS — Tue, once Week 8 unlocks
doFirst.title: Daniels back in at quarterback
doFirst.subtitle: Stroud started only for Washington's bye; Houston are on bye in Week 8. If the Loveland claim lands, Stroud is gone and Daniels simply goes in.

case.label: The move
case.body: Jayden Daniels (223.9 rest-of-season, ESPN) returns from the Week 7 bye. Stroud would score 0 in Week 8 on Houston's bye.

case.label: Also when the week rolls
case.body: Likely's Giants are on bye: Loveland (if claimed) takes the TE slot. Tuten returns from the Jaguars' bye; Tuesday's run sets the RB slots on Week 8 projections.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Daniels is ruled out for Week 8 with the elbow — then the QB slot needs a free agent, not this swap.

whatWentWrong.title: The Gordon claim closes WRONG — 17.3 on the bench today
whatWentWrong.lead: Never-resetting priority bought a back who started in none of Weeks 4-7.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Claimed 30 Sep for Lloyd. Benched in Weeks 4, 5, 6 and 7 (archive slots). Today he ran 25 times for 103 and a TD (NBC) while Jacobs, who took the slot by projection, had 4.9 mid-game.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Loveland claim is the opposite case: a starter in Week 8 on day one, at a position with no cover. That is the only kind of claim priority should buy.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Gordon becomes a regular starter here in Weeks 8-10 — the grade stays WRONG (it was about Weeks 4-7), but the roster spot would be justified.

whatWentWrong.title: Likely went 2 for 12 in McCarthy's first start — and is off next week
whatWentWrong.lead: The Giants changed quarterback and Nabers took the targets; their bye is Week 8.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Likely caught 2 of 4 for 12 (NBC Sports 25 Oct) after 11-13 targets three weeks running (archive). Nabers had 7 for 111 with McCarthy, who is expected to keep the job (NBC/Rapoport 25 Oct).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: One game does not move Likely — he stays the starter after the bye. But Week 8 needs a tight end, which is the Loveland claim.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Likely draws 8+ targets with McCarthy in Week 9 — then today was noise, as it most likely was.

worthALook.name: Michael Mayer
worthALook.lead: The fallback if the Loveland claim fails.

case.label: The player
case.body: 9 targets in Week 6 beside Bowers (Spectrum/AP 18 Oct); Bowers practised fully Friday (Raiders.com 23 Oct), so Mayer is the No. 2 tight end.

case.label: The cost
case.body: On waivers until Wed 01:00 CDMX, then free — add him Wednesday morning as a free agent rather than spend priority.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Loveland goes to another team on Wednesday; then add Mayer for Week 8, dropping Stroud. Changes if Bowers misses Week 8 (Mayer's role grows).

waiverAnalysis.summary: The weakest movable receiver is Rice (out again), but the receiver risers are vacancy or volume roles and priority never resets; the one priority-worthy add, Loveland, is a tight end and is the Do-first card. Kupp printed but is not in this league file's wire. Six weeks of data, still thin.
